summary: This bill expands the period during which an individual can file as a surviving spouse for tax purposes from two to five taxable years after their spouse's death, effective for returns filed for tax years beginning after December 31, 2024.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands the definition of a surviving spouse for tax filing purposes, allowing more individuals to use this status for a longer period. This change would likely result in lower tax liabilities for eligible individuals, thus reducing overall tax revenue.
